## v0.2.4 — Security & MQTTS camera-connection fixes

No configuration changes and no action required. Existing installs can apply this from the in-product **Updates** page.

### Fixes
- **MQTTS cameras now reconnect reliably after a certificate change.** Some cameras (e.g. Hanwha TNV-C8011RW and similar models) could fail to receive an updated trusted-CA certificate when re-enrolled — for example after the server's MQTT certificate authority was regenerated — leaving the camera unable to complete the secure (MQTTS) handshake and silently producing no events. The certificate is now correctly replaced on these cameras, so secure-MQTT enrollment and re-enrollment connect and stream events as expected.
- **Credentials are no longer written to application logs.** Camera request logging could, in some cases, record camera/broker credentials in plaintext in the backend logs. Logging is now clamped and a redaction safeguard strips any credentials (passwords, tokens, keys) from log output. Existing log files are unaffected by this change; only newly written logs benefit.

### Internal
- Added a regression test that locks in the corrected MQTTS certificate-unbind behavior across camera models.

_All container images were rebuilt for this release._
